angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop lateral force (Hoop G) and pass-rush-drill get-off vs NFL get-off, 1.5 s depth and pressure rate; year-standardized; baseline = pick + weight + EDGE share + NGS score + official 10-yd split and 3-cone, fit leave-one-class-out (least squares and ridge)
metric_name: Hoop G: peak half-second sideways acceleration (g) on the Run-the-Hoop curve, z within Combine year; used as a day-3 shortlist (top third of class)
headline_number: Held-out day-3 shortlist (pick 103+ or UDFA, top-third Hoop G): 8 of 15 (53%) beat the no-tracking pressure forecast vs 8 of 32 (25%) of other day-3 rushers; random-label p 0.032; ahead in 3 of 3 classes; +5.4 pressures per 450 rushes [-0.5, 11.5]. Continuous slope 0.43 per 100 rushes per sd [0.09, 0.77], same under ridge and rescaled forecasts; search-adjusted p 0.12. Clubs did not price it (3% later per sd).
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round 12 cand_1 (8.14) applying the round-12 judges' top_changes that transfer: (1) the positive use is now the headline, a frozen, hashed day-3 shortlist rule with a held-out hit rate against a base rate (comparison group = other day-3/UDFA rushers), random-label null, per-class counts, drop-best-player, ridge yardstick and a survival check (shortlist reached 30+ rushes at the same rate); (2) ridge and per-class-rescaled forecasts reported next to the least-squares one in the main table (all 0.43); (3) main tests table cut from 11 to 5 rows, jargon (skeptical prior, shuffle, Holm-style detail) moved to an appendix ledger, Fig 3 labels de-jargoned; (4) new hero Fig 1 (shortlist vs base rate by class, thirds set pre-draft, median pick by third), every figure number generated from the same variables as the text; calibration figure dropped (numbers in appendix); (5) role-specific 2025 shortlist card (EDGE wide-alignment third-down snaps vs interior stunt looper) replacing the generic card, case labels moved to shortlist language and an explicit drill-vs-tape disagreement (Adebawore); (6) the get-off angle stated plainly: drill burst carries to NFL get-off (rho 0.32) but not to pressure; 1,815 words by check.py, 1,959 by wc -w; 3 figures + 4 tables.
open_risks: The shortlist rule was written in round 13 after earlier rounds saw the Hoop G slope; only the frozen 2026 test is clean, and Hoop G was the best of 14 drills (search-adjusted p 0.12).
Small counts: 15 shortlisted vs 32 comparison rushers; the pressure-per-450 gap interval [-0.5, 11.5] touches zero and 2025 is 2 of 6 vs 3 of 13.
The forecast is fit on 100+-rush regulars, so day-3 rushers mostly fall below it; the shortlist 'hit' is relative to other day-3 rushers, not to 50%.
No in-game mechanism: Hoop G does not move 1.5 s depth or turning rate on sampled frames; the drill get-off that does carry over does not predict pressure.
Role-specific plans are rule-generated from rookie numbers and role, not from play-call data; team and scheme context comes from loop rates on about 20 sampled rushes.
